property_summary: After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, totalSupply must equal the sum of balances of all addresses from the public balanceOf getter.
After any sequence of calls including a call to allowance, totalSupply is always greater than or equal to the balance of the contract itself.

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, totalSupply must be equal to the sum of balanceOf of the address(0) caller and the contract itself (the only addresses that ever hold tokens in this contract).
The totalSupply must always equal the sum of balances of all addresses that ever appear as arguments or the contract itself after a call to allowance.
After any sequence ending with a call to allowance, totalSupply is always equal to the sum of all recorded LP balances (mapSynth_LPBalance) across all pools that have interacted.

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), the totalSupply must be at least the sum of balances of all addresses that have been minted to (in practice, it must not decrease due to missing addition).
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), totalSupply must equal the sum of all token balances (i.e., totalSupply() == sum of balanceOf() over all addresses).

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), totalSupply must be at least as large as the balance of any single address (i.e., totalSupply() >= c.balanceOf(addr) for all addresses fuzzed).

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), the totalSupply must not be less than the sum of balances of all addresses that have been minted to (i.e., totalSupply() >= sum of all balanceOf() for addresses that received tokens via _mint).

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), the totalSupply must be equal to the sum of balances of all addresses that were involved in the test (i.e., totalSupply() == balanceOf(sender) + balanceOf(spender)).
The totalSupply is monotonically decreasing when burning tokens.
After any sequence of calls that ends with allowance(), totalSupply of C remains unchanged.
After any call to allowance, the totalSupply of C is equal to the sum of all balanceOf values of C.

The totalSupply of C is always bounded above by the sum of all possible supply changes, but specifically, after a call to allowance, the totalSupply must be exactly the balanceOf of the contract itself (since only the contract holds tokens).
After a call to any function that does not involve state-modifying operations, the totalSupply of C remains unchanged.
After calling allowance, totalSupply is invariant (does not change from its initial value).
After an allowance call, totalSupply equals the initial totalSupply (0).
After calling allowance, totalSupply is unchanged from its value before the call.
The totalSupply after calling allowance(address,address) should never decrease below its previous value.
The totalSupply of the C contract equals zero after any sequence of operations ending with an allowance call.
After a call to allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPBalance of any pool address that was the caller of a previous burnSynth must have decreased by at most the amount of LP tokens burned.
After calling allowance, if burnSynth is called by a pool, mapSynth_LPBalance[pool] must not change when _amountUnits is zero.
After allowance() returns, mapSynth_LPBalance[token] is always as expected from previous burnSynth operations, but a zero _amountUnits in burnSynth should not decrement mapSynth_LPBalance.
After allowance() is called, mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool that called burnSynth with zero _amountUnits must not be decreased.
After allowance() is called, for any pool that previously called burnSynth with _amountUnits == 0, mapSynth_LPBalance(pool) must not have decreased.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance of msg.sender remains unchanged.
After any public function call, the return value of allowance(k, k) is always 0 for any address k.
After a call to allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance of any address that was not the caller or the spender remains unchanged.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the value of mapSynth_LPBalance at any address that was never a caller or a spender in any previous call remains unchanged.

After any sequence of public function calls ending with allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance for all addresses equals the sum of pool LP balances held by the contract (i.e., the total LP tokens the contract has ever received from pools).
After calling allowance from a random caller, the mapSynth_LPBalance of that caller remains unchanged if the synthetic amount held by the contract is zero.

After any call to allowance(address,address) completes, mapSynth_LPBalance of any previously uncalled pool remains unchanged when the synthetic amount held by C is zero and the caller is not a curated pool.
After allowance() is called, the mapSynth_LPBalance of any address that is not a curated pool and does not hold LP tokens from any pool remains unchanged when C's balanceOf(address(this)) is zero.
After calling allowance from any caller, the mapSynth_LPBalance of the caller is not decremented unless the synthetic amount held by C is non-zero.
After a call to allowance(address,address), the mapSynth_LPBalance of the caller is not decremented when the synthetic amount held by C is zero.
After allowance is executed, the mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool remains unchanged.
After allowance is called, the mapSynth_LPBalance for the pool address remains unchanged.

After allowance is called with the pool address as spender, the mapSynth_LPBalance for that pool does not decrease below a threshold that would allow the vulnerable realise function to incorrectly subtract.
After any call to allowance, the mapSynth_LPBalance for any address is unchanged from its current value.
The `mapSynth_LPBalance` for any address remains unchanged after a call to `allowance` (which does not write to that mapping).
After calling allowance, the debt for the caller's pool address should remain at least the amount minted.
After calling allowance on the synth contract, the mapSynth_LPDebt for the pool that last called mintSynth should be at least the amount passed to mintSynth.
Calling allowance on a synthetic token contract does not change mapSynth_LPDebt for any pool.

After calling allowance, the mapSynth_LPDebt[pool] value is monotonic non-decreasing: it never decreases from a previous value when that pool's external call sequence is limited to mintSynth and allowance.
After calling allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPDebt across all pools that have ever called mintSynth is at least the total amount of synthetic tokens minted through those calls.
After calling allowance with arbitrary arguments, the mapSynth_LPDebt value for any address should not be zero if that address had a previous non-zero debt and that debt was not fully consumed.
After a call to allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPDebt for any address should be a decreasing function of the amount parameter in burnSynth, never resetting to zero when there was prior debt.

After allowance(address,address) is called, mapSynth_LPDebt[caller] must equal the same address's balance of this contract minus the units burned from that address's LP balance, respecting the invariant that debt changes only by the amount of synthetic tokens burned.

After any call to allowance(address,address), the mapSynth_LPDebt of any address must be less than or equal to its previous value, i.e., it can only decrease or stay the same, never be set to zero when it was previously non-zero without an equivalent decrease in another mapping.

After any call to allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPDebt of any address equals the previous value minus the amount of synthetic tokens burned from that address, and is never reset to zero when there was prior debt.
